text:
jamie (AE): Hey team, Ignite Labs is asking for a 60-day POC and wants $25k in credits up-front to cover peak usage. Any objections? :thinking_face:
li (SE): quick context — their workload is token-heavy (long contexts, lots of embeddings for retrieval). They want dedicated throughput for 2 weeks during spike window.
devon (RevOps): $25k sounds high for a startup POC, but if there's a clear path to commit we can consider a grant + convert-to-commit clause. Do we have ARR/contract signal?
jamie (AE): They're pre-seed but an existing partner in our partner network. CTO said they'd move to a 6-month paid pilot if the POC meets latency/SLA. I noted potential for referral credits.
li (SE): Technically we should specify model variants + quantization plan. Suggest: give credits scoped to hosted API only (no private) and cap API concurrency to avoid abuse. Also add automatic fallback to smaller model to save tokens.
devon (RevOps): Can we set the grant as: $15k unrestricted credits + $10k contingency that unlocks on signed Letter of Intent? That way we protect spend. Also need a short justification for deal desk.
marta (Legal): I'll need to confirm the TOS exception for credits and any special termination language. Also, if they later request Dedicated or Private, that will require MSA and security addendum.
sales-bot: Policy snippet: "Startup grants <= $20k can be approved by RevOps. >$20k requires Deal Desk + VP Sales sign-off." Link: https://redwood.internal/policy/grants
jamie (AE): OK that policy link helps. I'll ask them to sign LOI for the $10k unlock. Is Deal Desk likely to push back if we mark this as "partner pilot"?
devon (RevOps): If you label it "partner pilot -> conversion path" and include basic KPIs (monthly active users, latency <200ms 95th, conversion intent), Deal Desk usually greenlights. Prepare a 1-page summary + usage estimate.
li (SE): Also need security checklist answered: SOC2 status, SSO (SAML/OIDC), data residency requirements. Ignite said they do not need on-prem for POC but want SOC2 info.
marta (Legal): I'll pull the SOC2 cert and limited security statement. If they push for SCC or DSAs, escalate.
jamie (AE): I will draft the 1-pager and LOI and push back on the $25k -> propose the split.
devon (RevOps): Ping me with that 1-pager. I'll pre-fill Deal Desk template and route for approval.
li (SE): For the POC config, recommend these settings — model: rwd-medium-8k, token cap per request: 6k, concurrency cap: 20, caching: enabled. Paste this in the 1-pager under technical scope.
jamie (AE): Copy that. I'll include `model: rwd-medium-8k` and the caps.
marta (Legal): If Deal Desk approves, we'll add a short credit grant addendum referencing the LOI and usage caps.
jamie (AE): thanks all. I'll update thread with the LOI and 1-pager. :thumbsup:
li (SE): One more small ask — please collect their expected token volume/week so we can pre-warm capacity.
jamie (AE): noted, will ask.
devon (RevOps): Tentative next step: jamie to post 1-pager by EOD, then I kick off Deal Desk review.
jamie (AE): On it.
(automated): deal-desk-bot added a checklist item: "Grant > $20k requires VP sign-off"
jamie (AE): cc @vp-sales in the LOI when I send it.
